meta.feature_title: Product Requirements Document: Service Touch Map

summary.executive_summary:
Multi-Dimension Review completed for: Product Requirements Document: Service Touch Map

**Total Findings:** 22
- Critical: 3
- High: 7
- Medium: 9
- Low: 1

**By Dimension:**
- Security (STRIDE/OWASP): 7 findings
- Engineering (Quality/Testing): 15 findings

**Change Summary:** adds external integrations
**Risk Score:** 15/100

⚠️ **Critical Issues Require Immediate Attention**
- [SECURITY] Lack of Authentication on API Endpoints
- [ENGINEERING] No Test Coverage
- [ENGINEERING] Zero test coverage creates significant development risk

findings.title: Payment Integration Security
findings.description: Payment processing integration requires PCI-DSS compliance considerations. Ensure card data never touches your servers.
findings.recommendation: Follow PCI-DSS guidelines for payment handling

findings.title: Third-Party Data Leakage
findings.description: External integration may expose data to third parties
findings.recommendation: Review data sharing with external services

findings.title: Lack of Authentication on API Endpoints
findings.description: The API endpoints listed in the current state do not require authentication. This means that any user, including unauthorized users, can access these endpoints and potentially modify or retrieve sensitive data. This is a significant security risk as it allows unauthorized access to the system's functionalities.
findings.recommendation: Implement authentication mechanisms for all API endpoints to ensure that only authorized users can access them.

findings.title: Potential Information Disclosure via External Integrations
findings.description: The integration with external services such as Stripe, SendGrid, and AWS X-Ray introduces potential information disclosure risks. If these integrations are not properly secured, sensitive data could be exposed to unauthorized parties.
findings.recommendation: Ensure all data transmitted to and from external services is encrypted. Use secure channels such as HTTPS and implement strict access controls.

findings.title: Missing Authorization Checks on API Endpoints
findings.description: The API endpoints do not have explicit authorization checks to ensure that the user has the necessary permissions to perform actions. This could allow users to perform actions they are not authorized to, such as modifying or deleting data.
findings.recommendation: Implement role-based access control (RBAC) to ensure that users can only perform actions they are authorized for.

findings.title: Lack of Input Validation on API Endpoints
findings.description: The API endpoints do not have sufficient input validation, which could lead to injection attacks such as SQL injection, command injection, or cross-site scripting (XSS).
findings.recommendation: Implement input validation and sanitization for all user inputs to prevent injection attacks.

findings.title: Potential Hardcoded Secrets
findings.description: The presence of potential hardcoded secrets in the codebase poses a security risk. Hardcoded secrets such as API keys, passwords, or tokens can be easily extracted by attackers, leading to unauthorized access.
findings.recommendation: Remove hardcoded secrets from the codebase and use secure vaults or environment variables to manage them.

findings.title: Low Test Coverage
findings.description: Test coverage is insufficient for confident deployments
findings.recommendation: Increase test coverage, especially for critical paths
mitigations: Add unit tests for business logic
Add integration tests for API endpoints
Implement test coverage requirements in CI

findings.title: Missing Tests for Affected Code
findings.description: Code changes affect areas without test coverage
findings.recommendation: Add tests before modifying untested code
mitigations: Add tests for the happy path
Add edge case and error tests

findings.title: Insufficient Logging
findings.description: Logging is insufficient for debugging and monitoring
findings.recommendation: Add structured logging for observability
mitigations: Add logging at key decision points

findings.title: No Health Checks
findings.description: Service lacks health check endpoints for monitoring
findings.recommendation: Implement health check endpoints

findings.title: No CI/CD Pipeline
findings.description: Project lacks automated CI/CD pipeline
findings.recommendation: Set up CI/CD pipeline for automated testing and deployment

findings.title: No Linting Configuration
findings.description: Project lacks linting configuration for code consistency
findings.recommendation: Configure linting tools for consistent code style

findings.title: Feasibility Assessment: Challenging
findings.description: Implementing the Service Touch Map feature is challenging due to the large codebase size, lack of test coverage, and absence of CI/CD. However, existing API endpoints and data models can be leveraged. Architectural fit: moderate. Refactoring needed: significant.

findings.title: Implementation Time Estimate
findings.description: Based on codebase analysis, estimated implementation time is 60-120 days (realistic: 90 days). Confidence: medium.
findings.recommendation: Review breakdown by phase for detailed planning.

findings.title: No Test Coverage
findings.description: The codebase lacks test coverage, which will make it difficult to ensure the reliability and stability of new features.
findings.recommendation: Develop a comprehensive test suite to cover new and existing functionality.

findings.title: Zero test coverage creates significant development risk
findings.description: The codebase has 0 test files and 0.0 test-to-code ratio, making it extremely risky to add new features without breaking existing functionality
findings.recommendation: Build comprehensive test suite for new service discovery features and critical existing paths

findings.title: Lack of CI/CD Pipeline
findings.description: The absence of a CI/CD pipeline will slow down development and deployment processes, increasing the risk of integration issues.
findings.recommendation: Implement a CI/CD pipeline to streamline development and deployment.

findings.title: Service discovery patterns need to be established
findings.description: No existing patterns for identifying services in codebases - need to define what constitutes a service across different architectures
findings.recommendation: Research common service patterns (microservices, modules, APIs) and create configurable discovery rules

findings.title: External integrations (AWS X-Ray, Stripe, SendGrid) add complexity
findings.description: PRD mentions external service integrations which may require additional authentication, configuration, and error handling patterns
findings.recommendation: Start with local service discovery, add external integrations as Phase 2

findings.title: No CI/CD pipeline increases deployment risk
findings.description: Without automated testing and deployment, manual verification increases development time and error risk
findings.recommendation: Implement basic CI/CD pipeline or establish rigorous manual testing procedures

findings.title: Service discovery performance on large codebases
findings.description: With 80K+ lines of code, service discovery needs to be efficient to avoid timeout issues
findings.recommendation: Implement caching and incremental discovery patterns
